Discover MCP API Changelog
Your data, your choice.

Give an app access to your share, the whole wind farm, or both. Connections are read-only and cannot change your account. Apart from ownership wattage and your wind-speed preference, personal account information is not shared.

Create a key under Account → API keys, or follow an app's dashboard sign-in and permission prompts. See the app connection guide for setup details.

Readings default to your share when permitted; whole-farm-only keys default to the whole wind farm. Use scope=site for whole-farm readings when your key allows it. Wind and capacity factor do not change with your share. Response timestamps are in UTC. Do not cache or share responses between accounts.

The default limit is 120 requests per minute per account, shared across its keys. A 429 Too Many Requests response includes a Retry-After header telling you how long to wait. Contact support if you need a higher limit.

API changelog

New features and improvements available through the API and connected AI assistants.

25 October 2026

  • Integrations: discover ways to use your Kirk Hill data in Home Assistant and compatible AI assistants, with API documentation, MCP setup and the API changelog together in the same section.

23 October 2026

Existing connections will continue to work.

  • Wind-speed preferences: connected apps can use your preferred wind-speed unit.
  • Generation forecasts: see predicted generation for the rest of today and tomorrow.
  • More detailed history: explore generation and wind readings by turbine and time interval, plus running generation totals.
  • Statistics and records: access daily and monthly figures, compare years and explore the wind farm's best-performing periods.
  • Expected generation: compare actual generation with P50, P75 and P90 expectations.
  • Weather forecasts: access predicted wind speed, wind direction, temperature and air pressure.
  • CO2 avoided forecasts: see indicative CO2 savings predicted for the rest of today and tomorrow.
  • Easier setup: expanded connection guides, including instructions for AI assistants.
  • Easier API testing: sign in to the documentation and try requests with temporary access, an existing account key or a pasted key.

August 2026

  • CO2 avoided: access indicative CO2 savings for your share or the whole wind farm over a selected period.

July 2026

  • AI assistant connections: ask compatible AI assistants about generation, wind and turbine readings.
  • Current readings: access current power, wind speed, turbine activity, capacity factor and today's generation.
  • Whole-farm-only access: connect apps to whole-wind-farm data without sharing your ownership wattage.
  • Connection guide: added guidance for connecting apps through dashboard sign-in and consent.

June 2026

  • API introduced: connect apps to generation, wind-speed and turbine data for your share or the whole wind farm.
  • Getting started: published setup guidance and examples.
